description: Every risk radar the brief published over recent weeks, in one call — each dated board with its regime and its risks, oldest first: which risks are new, which have been carried for weeks, which dropped off, and how their trend, impact and probability moved. The brief rephrases the same risk from day to day, so risks are not linked across boards. days_back 7..90, default 30. detail trades size for depth: 'counts' is grades only, 'titles' adds each risk's title, 'full' (default) adds why each risk matters — a 90-day pull is roughly a third the size at 'counts'.
name: track_risk_evolution
title: Track risk evolution
